name: Fatal Vows
description: When marriages fall apart, divorce can turn ugly - even deadly. From blushing brides turned cold-blooded killers to smitten grooms with shocking dark sides, the criminal psychology behind deadly divorces is examined. Guiding viewers through actual stories of love gone wrong are psychotherapist Stacy Kaiser and forensic psychologist Dr. Brian Russell, who analyze each couple to better understand how the marriage turned from flawed to fatal. .

videos.title: Dead Silence
videos.overview: Bob and Becky Klosterman are a model couple - fit, attractive and well spoken. Bob is a retired high ranking Navy commander and Becky a busy homemaker. Their life seems ideal, until one of them snaps. Suddenly, their prefect life explodes at the seams.

videos.title: Blood and Wine
videos.overview: When Nancy Lyon mysteriously dies in hospital, suspicions soon fall on her husband Richard. But soon other suspects are revealed: could it have been her brother? Did Nancy take her own life? Or did she deliberately try and frame her husband?

videos.title: Secrets of a Dying Man
videos.overview: Angelo Heddington and Elizabeth Rudavsky have a whirlwind romance that is followed by a shotgun wedding and news they're having a baby. But their union is built on layers of outrageous lies and the escalating violence will culminate in tragedy.

videos.title: The Last Seduction
videos.overview: Soon after John Pitman and Tracey Richter are married, John fears for his life. The family pets disappear, Tracey pulls a gun, and a private eye claims that Tracey is out to get him. But a neighbor ends up dead and Tracey says that John is behind it all.

videos.title: Death in the Family
videos.overview: Kraig and Karen Kahler enjoy a life of influence and privilege in the town of Weatherford Texas. Just beneath the surface of their marriage however lies a mix of sexual obsession and control that will spin out of control and destroy everything they have.

videos.title: Lies and Death
videos.overview: Donna and Gulam Moonda are the envy of many. She's an all-American girl and he's a wealthy doctor more than twenty years her senior. Their romance thrives, until a mystery gunman blows away the façade of perfection.

videos.title: Your Cheatin' Heart
videos.overview: Chris and Karon Pugh seem like a model working class couple living in a small seaside town. The neighbors admire their spotless house, and busy schedule. But the clean house hides some very dirty secrets that will result in unimaginable violence.

videos.title: Exquisite Lies
videos.overview: Daryl and Dante Sutorius, revel in the luxuries of their exclusive Cincinnati neighborhood. They have a pristine home with a Jaguar parked out front. But the newly married couple has dark secrets that will tragically unravel.

videos.title: The Edge of Love
videos.overview: High school sweethearts Bob Duke and Liana Davidson marry young and have their first baby soon after. But the shattered dreams of youth will plunge one of them to depths of despair - and the other to the bottom of a cliff.

videos.title: The Pastor, His Wife, Their Son, and His Mistress
videos.overview: When detectives find Pauletta Burleson murdered outside her home, the evidence appears stacked against her husband Pastor Tracy Burleson. But a trail of strained relationships and a sordid love triangle soon reveal more than one person wanted her dead.

videos.title: Half-Baked Alaska
videos.overview: Angela Neal comes to Anchorage, AK, to escape her checkered past. She falls in love and marries her counselor Mike Dixiano. But soon vices long buried will come back to haunt them... And demons from the past will drive one of them into the grave.

videos.title: In a Lonely Place
videos.overview: Michael Dally and Sherri Guess are a perfect match. But when Michael takes up with an alluring colleague named Diana in a not-so-secret affair, the fear of divorce will lead the couple down a dark path of jealousy, abuse, conspiracy... and human sacrifice.

videos.title: Romance Reloaded
videos.overview: High school sweethearts Michelle and Britt rekindle their romance after nearly 20 years apart. But this small-town Georgia family is a far cry from the Brady Bunch, bringing unseen baggage that unleashes a nightmare of infidelity, violence and murder.

videos.title: An Inconvenient Marriage
videos.overview: Cristobal helps Jennifer through a tough sickness, and she's grateful enough to marry him. But after they tie the knot, Jennifer discovers Cristobal's manic need to psychologically abuse her. The need worsens when she leaves him for another man.

videos.title: Not in Kansas Anymore
videos.overview: Kelly and Punkie are teenagers in love. They marry almost as soon as the law will allow, and plan to raise children in rural Kansas. But things take a deadly turn when they befriend Tammy and Jerry, a sexually adventurous couple with a need for speed.

videos.title: The Other Side of the Tracks
videos.overview: When Ed Postma, a Florida truck driver with a bad boy reputation, meets single mom Jackie Rosser, sparks fly. But when Ed straightens out to become a family man, new bad boys are waiting, and the spark dies, taking another casualty as collateral damage.

videos.title: Unholy Trinity
videos.overview: Amanda and Tonch Weldon seem like the quintessential Iowa farming couple. But behind closed doors, their cravings are quite kinky. Their secret swinging lifestyle works well for years... Until one day a deadly love triangle emerges.

videos.title: Black Pearl
videos.overview: Tammy Ellis likes bad boys and charismatic loner David Gatlin is right up her street. After a quickie marriage, David's dark history is revealed; an attempted divorce is the catalyst for a terrifying and bloody confrontation.

videos.title: Final Notice
videos.overview: After a rocky start, and a bad gamble on the stock market, Shari and Dwight Tobyne escape their small-town roots to start over. But financial fraud is soon revealed, turning this marriage into a web of deception - and ultimately a gruesome tragedy.

videos.title: Descent Into Madness
videos.overview: Janene and Troy Patton are madly in love. But with 4 kids, and unexplained black holes in the family bank accounts, they are on the brink of financial disaster. Then when Janene claims one of her psychiatric patients raped her, the fallout proves deadly.

videos.title: Dazed and Deadly
videos.overview: Amanda Hornsby falls for Woody Smith, who is nothing like her first husband, who stole her money. But, Woody has baggage of his own. A toxic cocktail of jealously, infidelity and energy drinks plunges them both into an abyss of sex and violence.

videos.title: Black Widow
videos.overview: Sharon and Perry Nelson shake off their former spouses and fall for each other. But as the relationship falters, a new lover, lurking on the fringes of the family, threatens to introduce more than a dash of violence into an already volatile mix.

videos.title: Burning Love
videos.overview: Hattie Rennolds is struggling to provide for her daughter in Baton Rouge when she meets her dream man. Within a year they're married and Hattie is pregnant. But when they divorce, chaos enters an already volatile custody dispute, and someone ends up dead.

videos.title: Mid-Life Murder
videos.overview: Arthur Burney believes it's true love when he runs off with Patricia Meeks, the waitress from his favorite bar. And soon Arthur and Patricia have a daughter of their own. But 16 years later, tensions are stretched to the limit, and someone will snap.

videos.title: Death Of A Salesman
videos.overview: John Parker marries Judy, a nice girl from the wrong side of the tracks. John uses his wealth and status to keep his new wife happy. But Judy's rumored romantic entanglements with a string of John's employees prove to be too much for John to bear.

videos.title: Big League Murder
videos.overview: Tommy and Tamara Kane appear to have it all. He's a pro football player for the Seattle Seahawks; she’s a devoted mother living in Montreal. Distance keeps this couple together, but when Tommy's career ends, the proximity will tear them apart.

videos.title: Murder By Proxy
videos.overview: Marcia's relationship with Texas trucker James endures resentment from Marcia's teenage daughter Shaina. But devotion knows no bounds. Things are looking up until greed and deceit set off a chain reaction that leads to six arrests, and one dead body.

videos.title: Death For Dessert
videos.overview: Sparks fly when picture-perfect divorcés Tami and Alan meet at a wedding - within months they’re married too. But when Tami starts uses her sultry good looks to get what she wants from every man she meets, one of them will end up dead.

videos.title: Killing Time
videos.overview: Karla and Ray Porter are the envy of their neighbors. But after more than 20 years of marriage, Karla's loyalties are no longer with Ray. When he unearths her betrayal, his own dark side is revealed, and a bizarre chain of events is set into motion.

videos.title: Hanging By A Thread
videos.overview: Tanya Buschman is just getting out of a nasty marriage when she falls for handsome Michel Bérubé, a bartender in Montreal. But it’s not long before jealousy becomes foreplay for a suspicious suicide that has friends pointing fingers at friends.

videos.title: Hunting Season
videos.overview: Tammy wins the heart of Larry, and their lives seem perfect. But Tammy starts looks to other men to occupy her time. As Larry grows suspicious, their marriage disintegrates into a high stakes hunt that will leave one dead and the other behind bars.

videos.title: No Accident
videos.overview: High school baseball coach Russell Stager is only separated from his wife for a few months when he meets Barbara. But less than a decade later, marital bliss will be replaced with a web of lies and betrayal that will push someone over the edge.

videos.title: The Devil Inside
videos.overview: When music promoter Tony Smith finds former actress, Lilius Landrum, he marries her. But Tony soon learns that Lilius is still legally married to someone else. The couple sets off together down a dark path that ends with the most horrific sin of all.

videos.title: Bloody Matrimony
videos.overview: Steve Dingle, a young Filipino immigrant, returns to his homeland to find a bride. It seems like a match made in heaven when he meets Cathy. But pressure builds in their marriage that will explode into infidelity, violence, and murder.

videos.title: Broken Dreams
videos.overview: The only thing going for Christina Corrigan is Keith Belajonas, a 25-year-old she meets online. After a couple of years and kids, they marry. But the honeymoon won't last long, and the jagged edges of their broken dreams will lead to a blood bath.

videos.title: Death In Vegas
videos.overview: John and Evie Watson manage to bridge the gap between their ages, cultures and languages. But after more than a quarter century of marriage-the pillars of their love have crumbled to pieces causing tempers to flare and secrets to be uncovered.

videos.title: You Only Die Once
videos.overview: Wild-child Kim is on a mission to turn her life around when she meets Frank, a beacon of stability. They say opposites attract-but in this case it’s fatal attraction.

videos.title: Crazy Love
videos.overview: Pamela and Michael fall back in love, twenty years after the high school sweethearts break up. But the issues that first drove them apart have intensified over the years—and their second chance at love turns deadly.

videos.title: Country Killer
videos.overview: Rodeo star Matt Allen finds southern comfort in the arms of country girl Elsie Wells. Until she finds his best friend-and they all discover a thick gumbo of trouble.

videos.title: Jaws of Death
videos.overview: Charlie and Christine search for a simpler life in Vermont. But a terrible car crash uncovers secrets so complicated, they’re deadly.

videos.title: Murder in Store
videos.overview: Jerry Barker falls hard for Rebecca after the death of his first wife-and together they open a general store. But the shelf-life on their happiness is short-lived—and when it comes to murder, practice doesn't make perfect.

videos.title: Collision Course
videos.overview: Mike is a master mechanic whose courtship with Ellen is fast and furious. But the couple's union veers onto a collision course that ends in tragedy.

videos.title: Second Chance at Death
videos.overview: It’s love at second sight, when Antoinette and Spencer hook up at their ten-year high school reunion. But after decades of supporting her husband financially, Antoinette realizes she’d be better off without... And the consequences are tragic.

videos.title: The Harder They Fall
videos.overview: Tom and Juanita give their love one more shot when they take a second honeymoon. But for the Richardsons, there are no second chances-just a sharp cliff with a long way to fall.

videos.title: Death Brawl
videos.overview: A handsome marine lands the girl of his dreams. But the perils of their long distance love push these newlyweds to the edge. When Shari and Deon’s romance misfires in a tragic accident - the collateral damage is deadly.

videos.title: Fall From Grace
videos.overview: Lynn and David Bush are in love, in shape, and in tune with each other's values, views, and goals. So naturally, suspicions of infidelity are met with surprise. There’s no smoke without fire - can there be murder without a body?

videos.title: Sex, Lies, and Secret Texts
videos.overview: Cassie is a free-spirited bartender when she meets family-guy Brent - the rock to her roll. But a spark this intense is doomed to explode... and a bright light extinguishes in tragedy.

videos.title: Murder in the Cards
videos.overview: Gary and Helen have two kids, two cars, and a lot of love. When Gary's other love for blackjack becomes more of a habit than a hobby, he and Helen go to extraordinary lengths to recoup losses... leaving one behind bars and the other six feet under.

videos.title: At Death's Door
videos.overview: Lynn and Manfred Schockner are millionaire executives at an aerospace engineering company. But underneath their privilege and wealth lies a twisted rage that ends in a lethal conspiracy…

videos.title: Second Chance At Death
videos.overview: While mourning the death of his wife, Julian falls hard for his much-younger coworker Teresa. For a time, her spunk lifts him out of to his sorrows until a sordid affair plunges him even deeper into the abyss.

videos.title: Love In Flames
videos.overview: Janice thinks Brett is a good, old-fashioned country boy who just needs a woman's touch. Brett thinks she's the ideal woman to turn his country house into a home. As family tragedies mount, their dream of a perfect life together soon goes up in flames.

videos.title: Blood And Sand
videos.overview: California beauty Pegye meets ace volleyball player Eric on the pristine sands of Newport Beach. With good looks and success they look like they've got it all but hedonism comes at a price, and living the dream quickly becomes a waking nightmare.

videos.title: Rookie Mistake
videos.overview: Carli wants to be a cop instead, she marries one. And Jeff takes his role as protector a little more seriously than fun-loving Carli can handle. Her attempts to break free from the confines of wedlock sets off a chain of deadly events.

videos.title: Recipe For Death
videos.overview: Eric gives up the Marines to follow his dream as a baker, and believes he's found the sweetest confection possible when he falls for Constance on a blind date. These foodies indulge in the good life until a seven-year itch is scratched by murder.

videos.title: Murder In The Marina
videos.overview: Ed is a retired pilot whose sense of adventure is reawakened by a seaside encounter with the much-younger Denise. The couple sets up an idyllic life on a boat in a Florida marina until a sudden change in fortune rocks the couple's romantic seas forever.

videos.title: Hell On Earth
videos.overview: Luther is a minister's son who falls hard for a pastor's daughter, Anita. With love and faith, they make it work until the work runs out. And the crushing blow of failure turns heaven-on-earth into a bloody hell.

videos.title: Reduced To Ash
videos.overview: Julie and Keith's relationship stands the test of time. But after thirty-five years together, a profound restlessness seeps into their union's foundation. As these lifelong partners pursue very private adventures, their once fiery love is reduced to ash.

videos.title: Deadly Obsession
videos.overview: Tom and Lynette's love story spans decades from grade school to a posh house with a pool. But dark secrets from the bedroom bleed out onto other aspects of the marriage... and a dangerous obsession rips their romance into pieces.

videos.title: The Ties That Bind
videos.overview: Marc and Michelle's teenage romance is fast and serious. But these spring chickens have a hard time crawling out of their parents' nests causing delegate family ties to snap and break.

videos.title: A Thin Blue Line
videos.overview: High school sweethearts Linda and Derrick Yancey become sheriff's deputies with a picture-perfect marriage. But a closer look beyond the nice house and perfect lawn reveals a shocking tale of good cop/bad cop that can only end in a fugitive on the run.

videos.title: Drowning In Tears
videos.overview: When Tim meets Maryann at a Catholic mixer, it's a match made in heaven. But while the future looks bright, a dark cloud gathers on the horizon the shadow of Tim's ex-wife. Despite the best intentions, everyone knows that raising a family can be murder.

videos.title: Death Knows No Borders
videos.overview: Worlds collide when Donald and Umi fall in love in Indonesia. But as Umi strives to become the perfect American woman in Don's native Kentucky, he longs for something or someone more exotic and when this unorthodox family is divided only one can conquer.

videos.title: A Watery Grave
videos.overview: Jeff and Jeannine Glanda have a picture-perfect family until selfishness and a shameless affair mark the beginning of the end. As money troubles and the threat of divorce breed paranoia and hate, a plot is hatched in the dark heart of a twisted killer.

videos.title: Behind Closed Doors
videos.overview: Nurses Lara Crockett and Ricardo Muscolino meet on the night shift. He's ambitious and sets about creating a rich life for them and she's happy to go along. But his scheming eventually drives Lara into the arms of another man with explosive results.

videos.title: Love Gone Bankrupt
videos.overview: A gold-digging socialite meets a wealthy real estate mogul. Soon, Gary and Pam Triano's whirlwind romance results in marriage, shady business deals, betrayals, and one very bitter custody battle. It eventually leads to a climax that's nothing short of explosive.

videos.title: The Bad Apple
videos.overview: Frank 'Nicky' Nicolosi Sr. and his devout new wife Ellie are living out the perfect retirement. But when one is found dead in an apple orchard, police discover that there's more to this seemingly frail and religious couple than anyone imagined.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Rick
videos.overview: Most high school love ends in heartbreak. But not Richard and Jolena's romance. Years later, their love is rekindled-- but one of them is married to someone else. Tempers flare, trust is betrayed and one in the triangle will end up dead.

videos.title: Ambition to Die For
videos.overview: Long-time married couple Dino and Clara run a successful bail bond company. When Dino's long hours and a missing bail jumper make Clara suspicious and nervous, a hidden secret emerges that makes their bond come undone in the blink of an eye.

videos.title: Murder, Modesty and The Pastor
videos.overview: Corinne isn't a demanding woman - she just wants what many lonely people want: a second chance at love. And when she meets Calvin Stoudt she finally gets it. But a too-close roommate and a monstrous past turn this second chance into a deadly battleground.

videos.title: Curtain Call to Hell
videos.overview: Stephanie and Daniel are young, in love, and happily balancing work and play. But before long, tensions are set off by disappointment, self-loathing, and a mutual affection for the bottle. And by the final curtain call, only one of them is left standing.

videos.title: Death Outranks Love
videos.overview: It's a military match made in heaven for Roger and Margorie, but a tangled web of financial secrets and twisted lies ruins the young couple's future. While the rise of their careers and romance seems meteoric, the ensuing fall is deadly.

videos.title: Living with the Devil
videos.overview: When Darren and Elizabeth marry eight weeks after meeting, no one thinks it's a good idea. The couple just doesn't care. But when one partner is attacked, and a sniper is spotted across the way, could it be that everyone was right?

videos.title: Deceitful Secrets
videos.overview: Cecil and Larlane Brown have been together for years. But their secrets and lies, ignored and neglected for decades, threaten to turn their 50-year relationship into a bloody battleground.

videos.title: Sins of the Heart
videos.overview: Young, rich, and religious, John and Nikki Hillrich fall in love at college. It's a match made in heaven - but hell is not far off. When desire collides with faith, secret lives marked by sinful liaisons and menacing new friends shatter their perfect life.

videos.title: Bored to Death
videos.overview: When Opal Skidmore marries Steven Williams, their love is a second chance for the pair to live out their dreams until boredom and the lure of the open road spark hidden desires and sexual hijinks leaving this open marriage anything but happy.

videos.title: Murder Behind The Gates
videos.overview: Pad is rich and handsome, and Kem is popular - but from the wrong side of town. But the power couple stick it out despite disapproval, and over the years amass a fortune. They soon learn that their money can't buy love and happiness - only death.

videos.title: Honkytonk Killer
videos.overview: Shorty and Cotton seem perfect for each other: they love dancing, motorcycles and each other. But looks can be deceiving and after a tragic accident reveals a life of lies and deceit, one of them will ultimately dance with the devil to the death.

videos.title: Lethal Romance
videos.overview: An ambitious Harlem couple dreams of a better life for themselves. But stuck in a bitter cycle of poverty poor health and mistrust, one of them decides puts their dreams to rest, forever.

videos.title: Hell On Wheels
videos.overview: When the sexy and beautiful Charlene is around, sparks fly. But the sparks aren't limited to one man. One after another, Josh, Jace, Tim, and Casey all go crazy vying for her love. And while love is a many splendored thing, it can also have a body count...

videos.title: Some Like It Dead
videos.overview: When Mirinda marries Sam, everyone is happy — she's pretty; he's cute and friendly — until her spending veers out of control, tearing the couple apart. As the two fight it out, one of them looks outside the marriage - and finds nothing short of murder.

videos.title: No Harmony In Polyamory
videos.overview: An open-minded foursome soon discovers there's no harmony in polyamory, and someone will pay the ultimate price for free love.

videos.title: The Unholy Affair
videos.overview: Life for Syble and Earnie revolves around two things: church and family. But a freak accident, and a pair of wandering eyes, throw the marriage off-kilter, and threatens to drive this couple into an unholy trinity of betrayal, infidelity - and murder.

videos.title: My Way Or The Dead Way
videos.overview: Jodie was Edgar's secret high school crush. After a chance meeting, the two get together quickly. But money trouble, jealousy, and a rebellious stepdaughter are about to turn this second chance at love into the high school reunion from hell.

videos.title: Deadly Isolation
videos.overview: Chad and Jo meet by chance and to this pair of free spirits, their connection feels cosmic. They fall in love and move far from everyone they know. But soon their new life is ripped apart by jealous ex-partners, isolation, and a desperate need for control.

videos.title: Flirting With Murder
videos.overview: When Trichele and Brian promise to stick it out for better or for worse, they have no idea how 'worse' things will get. Their passionate love easily flips to bitter hate when the parties, drinking, and recriminations escalate until one of them is dead.

videos.title: To Kiss or To Kill
videos.overview: Despite the 15-year age gap between them, April and Brad Smith are happily married. But when his job forces him to be gone for days and weeks at a time, and April's dreams of motherhood fall apart, she turns to other men for consolation and one even moves in with the couple. When Brad is ultimately replaced as the man of the house, everyone pays a price.

videos.title: Betting on Murder
videos.overview: Gail and Stephen Dews have it all: a happy marriage, a beautiful house and healthy children, but a family tragedy and a gambling addiction rips their lives to shreds, proving that nothing is what it seems.

videos.title: Opposites Can Kill
videos.overview: Young single mom Kathy wants a good life for herself and her son. That life soon includes wannabe rap star Juan, who has ambitions of his own. But their dreams clash and tempers erupt when Kathy decides she wants more out of life - no matter what the cost.
